keywords.research_context: Quantum information and many-body physics group. Research lines: (1) multipartite entanglement characterization and low-complexity representations (entanglement witnesses, classical shadows, tensor networks); (2) 1D dissipative/open quantum systems and noise-resilient dynamics simulation (Lindblad dynamics, matrix product operators, quantum trajectories, error mitigation); (3) 2D many-body systems and lattice gauge theory co-simulation (PEPS, Schwinger model, gauge-matter coupling, Hamiltonian simulation); (4) quantum optimization algorithms in open systems (dissipative/open-system QAOA, quantum annealing under noise, quantum optimal control); (5) cold atom / neutral atom quantum computing and simulation (Rydberg atoms and blockade gates, optical lattices, optical tweezers, atom arrays, quantum gas microscopes).
